vulnerability_summary: Babylon skipped costaker reward-tracker subtraction when a BTC unbond made a finality provider leave the active set, leaving phantom active stake eligible for rewards.
causality: Human atomic commit f0f7d0d7448945f0384a6e0884090994ae0ad04d in focused PR #1731 introduced the exact vulnerable condition `!isFpActiveInPrevSet || !isFpActiveInCurrSet` to avoid a perceived double subtraction. Its message and commit contain no AI authorship signal. Human follow-up 933b6b2e33b8c1660d10b8fcabf8a2f55372a6e8 retained the condition, and squash a7c9a2828f213e8157ba60501dfcc0e43233f77e merged it without an AI trailer. Later 188-file costaking squash 77c301cc72b9851bd0ff9054370781028cf5a6c9 and backport commits b2d307ae423546bedfbde116e025f55f60f2b643 / 2bd9585607bd7b1c0905d21b92bcdb6d4c03bf36 aggregate many contributors and carry a generic Copilot coauthor among numerous trailers; they cannot transfer Copilot authorship to the already-existing human vulnerable line. Fix e65c3a55a398a403103f1b089cf76f0d4befc7a0 removes the current-set test, directly reversing f0f7d0d.

evidence.fix_binding: Changes the early return from previous-or-current inactive to previous inactive only.
